title: Record the denied command, not just the tool name
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: the run record keeps only 'Bash' for each denial, so the owner cannot tell which command was denied or fix the allowlist. Claude's result lists the denied command (permission_denials[].tool_input.command; fixture testdata/vendors/claude/04-allowlist-denies-write.stdout). Record it on the role, show it in ork status and the TUI detail, and bound its length. Take care: a command may contain secrets, so cap and note this.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A denied Bash call records its command text (first N characters) on the role.
- ork status and the TUI detail show it under the denial.
- A denied Write shows the file path, not the file content.
- Existing run records without commands still load.
